article.story: PROVIDENCE, R.I. -- — Landon Lewis had 26 points in Brown's 86-80 overtime victory against Columbia on Saturday. Lewis added nine rebounds for the Bears (7-9, 1-2 Ivy League). Jeremiah Jenkins scored 14 points and added nine rebounds, nine assists, and four steals. Isaiah Langham had 14 points and shot 6 of 9 from the field and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line. The Lions (12-5, 1-2) were led in scoring by Kenny Noland, who finished with 18 points. Blair Thompson added 12 points for Columbia. Miles Franklin also put up 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
